Blocks.Text: The creator analytics API returns analytics metrics for content created on LinkedIn. Currently, the API supports analytics metrics for videos, articles and newsletters. This API doesn’t share member personal data as part of the API response.
The service currently provides the following methods:

targetEntity Finder: Find a list of creator analytics data points for a metric of a target entity. The metricType and queryType determine the type of analytics data returned from this finder. e.g. If metricType = VIDEO_PLAY and queryType = DAILY_COUNT, the finder will return a list of data points representing video play count per day. Each data point includes video play count for a specific date. If metricType = ARTICLE_VIEW, queryType = ACTOR_DEMOGRAPHICS and dimension = INDUSTRY, the finder will return a list of data points representing top industry demographics. Each data point includes article view count for a specific industry.

Rows.Text: Retrieve analytics for pages content. Restricted to page admins with the following company page roles: ADMINISTRATORCONTENT_ADMINISTRATORANALYST

Blocks.Text: See Organization Access Control for more information on company page roles.
This DMA API has no member data that is obfuscated.

To protect viewer privacy, some demographic category results will not be shown until you have enough unique viewers in that category. See Help Center Article for more information regarding applying differential privacy on analytics demographic data.
This data represents a single analytics data point

Rows.Text: The target entity that the analytics data point is for. The URN type is determined by the content type:If the data point is for a video, this field is a ugc post URN (urn:li:ugcPost:123)If the data point is for an article, this field is an article URN (urn:li:article:123 or urn:li:linkedArticleUrn:456)If the data point is for a newsletter, this field is an contentSeries URN (urn:li:contentSeries:123)
Values: If the data point is for a video, this field is a ugc post URN (urn:li:ugcPost:123)
If the data point is for an article, this field is an article URN (urn:li:article:123 or urn:li:linkedArticleUrn:456)
If the data point is for a newsletter, this field is an contentSeries URN (urn:li:contentSeries:123)

Rows.Text: The value of the analytics data point. It is either an integer count or a float percentage number.

The metric type of analytics data point represents. Possible values are VIDEO_PLAYVIDEO_WATCH_TIMEARTICLE_VIEWNEWSLETTER_ARTICLE_VIEWNEWSLETTER_IMPRESSIONNEWSLETTER_SUBSCRIBERNEWSLETTER_ENGAGEMENTVIDEO_VIEWERARTICLE_VIEWER
The date range that the analytics data point represents. If the value covers the whole analytics data retention period of the target entity, this field is not set.
The dimension of the analytics data point. The field is present only if the requested queryType is ACTOR_DEMOGRAPHICS
The percentage change of the analytics data point. The field is missing if the percentage change is not available.

Blocks.Text: This represents a range of dates inclusive of start date and exclusive of end date.

Rows.Text: Represents the inclusive (greater than or equal to) value in which to start the range.
Represents the exclusive (strictly less than) value in which to end the range.

Blocks.Text: This represents a date in UTC timezone.
This represents the demographic dimension of a CreatorAnalyticsDataPoint

Rows.Text: Represents the type of demographic dimension. Possible values are ORGANIZATIONINDUSTRYSENIORITYREGIONORGANIZATION_STAFF_COUNT_RANGE

Represents the URN value of the demographic dimension. The URN type is determined by the dimension type.ORGANIZATION: OrganizationUrnINDUSTRY: IndustryUrnTITLE: TitleUrn or SuperTitleUrnSENIORITY: SeniorityUrnREGION: GeoUrnORGANIZATION_STAFF_COUNT_RANGE: StaffCountRangeUrn

Blocks.Text: This represents the percentage change in the metric value of a CreatorAnalyticsDataPoint

Rows.Text: Represents what the percentage change value is calculated against. Possible values are PREVIOUS_PERIOD: indicates the percentage is calculated against the previous period of the date range in CreatorAnalyticsDataPoint. For example, if the dateRange in the CreatorAnalyticsDataPoint is 7 days from 2020-01-08 to 2020-01-14, the percentage is calculated against the previous period with the same number of days: 2020-01-01 to 2020-01-07
Values: PREVIOUS_PERIOD: indicates the percentage is calculated against the previous period of the date range in CreatorAnalyticsDataPoint. For example, if the dateRange in the CreatorAnalyticsDataPoint is 7 days from 2020-01-08 to 2020-01-14, the percentage is calculated against the previous period with the same number of days: 2020-01-01 to 2020-01-07

Rows.Text: the finder name. It must be targetEntity

The target entity to get analytics data for. It should be an URN representing the content that the analytics data is fetched for. An activity URN and ugc post URN is required for the article and video analytics.A content series URN is needed for newsletter analytics.
Values: An activity URN and ugc post URN is required for the article and video analytics.
A content series URN is needed for newsletter analytics.

Rows.Text: The metric type of the target entity to get analytics data for. Possible values are VIDEO_PLAYVIDEO_WATCH_TIMEARTICLE_VIEW NEWSLETTER_ARTICLE_VIEWNEWSLETTER_IMPRESSIONNEWSLETTER_SUBSCRIBERNEWSLETTER_ENGAGEMENTVIDEO_VIEWERARTICLE_VIEWER

the type of the analytics query. If the query type is set to ACTOR_DEMOGRAPHICS, the demographic dimension must be specified. Possible values are TOTAL_COUNT: request for a total count for the metricDAILY_COUNT: request for a list of daily counts for the metricACTOR_DEMOGRAPHICS: request for demographic information for metric actors. This is only compatible with VIDEO_VIEWER, ARTICLE_VIEWER and NEWSLETTER_SUBSCRIBER metrics.
Values: TOTAL_COUNT: request for a total count for the metric
DAILY_COUNT: request for a list of daily counts for the metric
ACTOR_DEMOGRAPHICS: request for demographic information for metric actors. This is only compatible with VIDEO_VIEWER, ARTICLE_VIEWER and NEWSLETTER_SUBSCRIBER metrics.

Rows.Text: the date range to get analytics data for. If not specified, data across the full retention period of the target entity (retention period for a content can be found here) will be returned. This field is ONLY supported and REQUIRED for newsletter analytics requests for now. Possible values are: PAST_7_DAYSPAST_14_DAYSPAST_28_DAYSPAST_90_DAYSPAST_365_DAYS
